title: Poisoner's Robe
summary: Clothing that adds 1d4 Poison damage when you cast a spell that deals Poison damage.

fields.Poison Trails: Eligible Poison-damage spells deal an additional 1d4 Poison.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by the Phase Spider Matriarch in Whispering Depths, X −569, Y −359.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
